style.prompt: A whimsical handcrafted stop-motion miniature garden at sunrise. A tiny endearing brass robot with round glowing eyes stands beside a towering golden sunflower, both fully visible in vertical framing. In one continuous shot the robot carefully tips a tiny watering can, pouring sparkling water onto the soil at the sunflower's base. Warm backlight illuminates dew and textured handmade leaves. The sunflower gently bends toward the robot as if thanking it, and the robot looks up. Slow subtle camera push-in, tactile clay-and-metal miniature aesthetic, magical and heartwarming. Sound: gentle trickling water, soft mechanical chirps and garden ambience; no speech or music. No on-screen words, captions, logos or watermarks.
